# Troubleshooting

Check out the official [OpenTabletDriver Wiki](https://opentabletdriver.net/Wiki/FAQ/Linux) But in case you do, run:

``` bash
sudo rm /tmp/CoreFxPipe_OpenTabletDriver.Daemon
```

to stop the daemon from crashing when ran as user again.
